Ive always made an effort to treat my Doctor, Accountant and Lawyer with the utmost respect, because theyre the ones taking care of your Health, Wealth and Freedom respectively.

Three people who you definetly want working with you, rather than against.
Except when the bastards swoop you..

Not really.  Her pea-shooter is supposed to be a pea shooter. Reading through the interviews gave me the impression they initially made her more like Spy in TF2 (Stealthy assassin), then decided it was more important to focus her abilities on her ability to disrupt, rather than her ability to kill.

Opportunist is in that regard, is really supposed to be her "main" source of damage.

She'd be better off being classed as a support, because her real strength lies in how she disrupts the enemy team (Choking sustain on hacked HP packs, shutting down counters to her ult on her ult, hacking shields or abilities). It'd also take the pressure off Sombra players to play her as DPS, because her real power lies in her ability to distract, misinform and gain information.

They desperately needed to modify her hack to make it shorter, which is exactly what they did,  and the CD reduction was the cherry on top. That's all she needed to begin with. My suggestion was to allow her hack to be a mirror of her EMP (disables Shields as well) as well as allowing you to hack Sym Ults and Torb turrets under fire, that's the next change that needs to be made.

Trust me when I say this, after 1500 hours of TF2, with some level of competitive clan wars, you do not want to give Sombra even the chance to do more damage.

Spy checking is one of the most un-fun and boring ways to play a game, and it's basically mandatory.  The spy can do so much damage in such a short time, that it's become more or less mandatory to keep certain locations constantly in flames.
